selection: Four directly observed outer wooden front-board contour junctions, sorted by native(y,x). Upper-right is slightly higher in image than upper-left. No cue was chosen for expected after coverage.

proposals.cue_name: Upper-right outer corner of the top front wooden plank/rim
proposals.adjacent_part_lines: Long upper wood-to-background contour meets the right vertical end contour of the top front plank.
proposals.target_identity: Front-facing wooden bin/pallet structure, specifically its uppermost horizontal wooden front plank; green equipment is background.
proposals.before_visible_evidence: The wood front face and both adjoining outer boundaries are directly visible. This is a visible structural board-end junction rather than lettering or a selected mask-positive point.
proposals.ambiguity: Board edge is rounded/blurred over a few pixels and the upper contour has a slight slope. The proposed point denotes this region, not exact material membership or a calibrated cuboid vertex.
proposals.uncertainty_reason: Four-pixel halfwidth covers blur, rounding and uncertainty of the meeting of upper and right contours.
proposals.alternative_interpretation: Individual top-front board corner; not proven whole-bin top cuboid corner or an independently named native8 reference.
proposals.uncertainty_semantics: Half-open native XYXY region representing proposed contour-junction/localization uncertainty; not all pixels asserted to be wood or corner.

proposals.cue_name: Upper-left outer corner of the top front wooden plank/rim
proposals.adjacent_part_lines: Long upper wood-to-background contour meets the left vertical outer side of the top front plank.
proposals.target_identity: Same wooden front bin/pallet structure; the dark cabinet to the left/behind is a separate background object.
proposals.before_visible_evidence: The pale horizontal top edge turns downward into the visible outer left wood edge. The junction and adjacent wooden face are observed.
proposals.ambiguity: The cut board corner is slightly rounded and the exact intersection is spread across several pixels. Dark fasteners/wood marks are not the selected cue.
proposals.uncertainty_reason: Four-pixel halfwidth conservatively includes the rounded/blurred contour turn apparent in the native crop.
proposals.alternative_interpretation: Individual front board/rim corner, not proof of the virtual native8 top-left definition.
proposals.uncertainty_semantics: Half-open native XYXY region representing proposed contour-junction/localization uncertainty; not all pixels asserted to be wood or corner.

proposals.cue_name: Lower-left outer corner of the lowest wide front wooden plank
proposals.adjacent_part_lines: The plank left outer contour meets its lower nearly horizontal edge, above the narrower support/foot structure.
proposals.target_identity: Lowest wide front board of the same wooden bin; support wood beneath belongs to the same structure, floor to the left is background.
proposals.before_visible_evidence: The front plank face, downward outer boundary and lower overhanging lip are visible at the corner. This is the lower plank endpoint, not the floor-contact shadow.
proposals.ambiguity: Rounded board end and dark same-target support behind/below make the precise cut-edge location uncertain. Do not confuse this with the lower foot/base corner near the floor.
proposals.uncertainty_reason: Four-pixel halfwidth covers rounding and the few-pixel dark lip at the visible plank corner.
proposals.alternative_interpretation: Board-end junction at an overhang; it is not a global bounding-cuboid bottom corner.
proposals.uncertainty_semantics: Half-open native XYXY region representing proposed contour-junction/localization uncertainty; not all pixels asserted to be wood or corner.

proposals.cue_name: Lower-right outer corner of the lowest wide front wooden plank
proposals.adjacent_part_lines: Lower plank long bottom edge joins its right vertical outer edge over the narrower support structure.
proposals.target_identity: Lowest wide front board of the same wooden bin; light floor is background to its right and support wood lies inward/below.
proposals.before_visible_evidence: The lower plank outer silhouette and front face are directly observed. The bottom horizontal contour terminates at the right board end.
proposals.ambiguity: Blur/rounded edge and the nearby same-target support edge can shift a single-pixel intersection. The reference is for the front plank corner region, not the foot/floor contact or exact virtual bbox corner.
proposals.uncertainty_reason: Four-pixel halfwidth accommodates the rounded contour and separation of the plank lip from the support below.
proposals.alternative_interpretation: Individual visible plank outer endpoint, with native8 correspondence unproved.
proposals.uncertainty_semantics: Half-open native XYXY region representing proposed contour-junction/localization uncertainty; not all pixels asserted to be wood or corner.
